Crossline 内测版由个人开发者运营。下面说明这台服务器保存什么、交给谁处: The Crossline beta is run by an individual developer. Below is what this server keeps, who handles it, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
账号：邮箱，以及登录方式（验证码、密码或 Google）。: Account: your email and sign-in methods (code, password or Google).
本人提供的内容：访谈对话、上传的文件、主线与里程碑、任务与完成记录、画像报告和形: What you provide: interview conversations, uploaded files, tracks and milestones, tasks and their completion records, the portrait report and figure.
模型连接：每个账号在服务器上有自己的 Codex 目录，保存它的 ChatGPT: Model connections: each account has its own Codex folder on the server holding its ChatGPT sign-in; another model's API key is stored encrypted on the server, never in the ledger, exports or backups. All are kept apart from other accounts and never shared.
用量：每次模型调用的时间、耗时和 token 数，用来排查故障和控制负载，不含对: Usage: the time, duration and token count of each model call, used to troubleshoot and manage load, without any conversation content.
访谈、规划和整理由本人连接的模型完成：ChatGPT 账号按 OpenAI 的条: The interview, planning and organizing are done by the model you connect: a ChatGPT account under OpenAI's terms, another model's API under that provider's terms, always on your own quota.
用开发者模型邀请码的账号，访谈、规划和整理由开发者提供的模型完成：内容经这台服务: For accounts with an invite code for the developer's model, the interview, planning and organizing are done by that model: content goes through this server to SiliconFlow, on the developer's quota and under SiliconFlow's terms; each account has a monthly usage cap.
申请邀请码时，账号邮箱和填写的理由会通过邮件发给开发者审批。: When you apply for an invite code, the account email and the reason you give are emailed to the developer for approval.
画像形象图由火山方舟（字节跳动）绘制，只发送去掉个人信息的形象描述。: The portrait figure is drawn by Volcano Ark (ByteDance), which receives only a description of the figure with personal details removed.
登录验证码通过 Resend 发送邮件。: Sign-in codes are emailed through Resend.
不出售数据，不用于广告，不与其他账号共享。运营者能接触服务器，只在排查故障时查看: Data is never sold, used for advertising or shared with other accounts. The operator has access to the server and looks at logs and usage figures only to troubleshoot.
账号存在期间一直保存。服务器每天备份，备份保留 14 天，加密的异地副本保留 3: For as long as the account exists. The server is backed up daily, backups are kept 14 days and encrypted off-site copies 30 days: after an account is deleted, its copies in backups are gone within 30 days at most.
公开测评是独立的服务，结果 90 天后自动删除，结果邮件里有删除链接。: The public quick test is a separate service; its results are deleted automatically after 90 days, and the results email has a delete link.
设置 → 通用 → 删除账号：输入账号邮箱确认后，上面列出的内容立即删除，无法恢: Settings → General → Delete account: once you confirm with the account email, everything listed above is deleted at once and cannot be recovered.
只想断开模型：在设置 → 模型连接退出 ChatGPT 或移除其他模型，服务器上: To disconnect only the model: sign out of ChatGPT or remove the other model under Settings → Model connection, and the sign-in or API key on the server is deleted right away.
内测版运行在一台小服务器上，可能排队、中断或丢失数据，不承诺可用性。重要资料请自: The beta runs on one small server and may queue, stop or lose data; availability is not promised. Keep your own copy of anything important.
